title: Twindling Trees
description: This mod adds compatibility between Twindling Tweaks and More Trees, specifically with the wood ore.
body:
Welcome to Twindling Trees! This is a mod that adds cross-compatibility between More Trees and Twindling Tweaks! I hope you enjoy!

Twindling Trees is my third mod and my first compatibility mod!

This mod adds some new wood ores to match the wood types in Twindling Tweaks!

Stay tuned, because there will be more!

Have fun!

--Originally Uploaded To CurseForge--
